courses.name: Introduction to Programming
courses.description: Introduces programming concepts, problem solving, and basic programming logic.
courses.notes: Recommended starting course for students interested in software development.

courses.name: Programming Fundamentals
courses.description: Introduces programming structures, variables, decisions, and loops.

courses.name: Object Oriented Programming
courses.description: Introduces object-oriented programming concepts and application development.

prerequisites.note: Students must complete either COP1000 or COP2001. Both are not required.

courses.notes: Choose one qualifying introductory programming course.

courses.name: Advanced Programming
courses.description: Builds on programming fundamentals and introduces more advanced programming techniques.

prerequisites.note: COP2800 must be completed before enrolling.

courses.notes: Requires successful completion of Object Oriented Programming.

courses.name: Data Structures
courses.description: Covers data organization, algorithms, and common data structures.

prerequisites.note: Both prerequisite courses must be completed.

courses.notes: Students must complete both prerequisite courses.

courses.name: Computer Applications
courses.description: Introduces computer applications and productivity software.
courses.notes: No prerequisites in this demonstration dataset.

courses.name: Computer Operating Systems
courses.description: Introduces operating systems and basic computer system concepts.
courses.notes: Provides an introduction to computer operating systems.

courses.name: Software Development Project
courses.description: Applies programming and software development concepts to a larger project.

prerequisites.note: Both Advanced Programming and Data Structures must be completed.

courses.notes: Designed for students who have completed advanced programming coursework.
